idea: MV3 replacements for orphaned Edge (and Chrome) MV2 extensions, sold via small Pro tier
platform: Microsoft Edge Add-ons / Chrome Web Store
evidence: Edge: 32,478 listings; 3,339 still MV2 with 85.6M installs; ~3,287 listings / 7.9M installs have 'no MV3 successor and no announcement naming them' (exstats, 5 Sep 2026). Carried from v7 QUIET_CORNERS #1, not re-fetched.
moat_note: Weak moat: anyone can port an extension; launches into this gap not counted (no data). Window closes as Edge switch-off completes end-2026; first-mover listing/SEO is the only edge.

idea: Premium Bonds checker companion app (iOS first; Android already has a decent third-party)
evidence: iOS: NS&I checker 2.6★/1,357 ratings, last update 28 Nov 2024; NS&I main app 1.6★/306 (v7 QC). Google Play today: NS&I 'Premium Bonds prize checker' 3.6★, 1m+ downloads, updated 20 Nov 2024; NS&I app 1.4★, 500k+; third-party 'Premium Bonds Prize Checker +' 4.1★/92 reviews, 10k+, updated 4 Oct 2026. Winning numbers published free.
stated_problem: Reddit builder added email alerts that arrive 'days earlier than the official email' (r/premiumbonds, via v7 QC).
moat_note: Low moat: free data, trivial to clone. Android already has a 4.1★ indie app; iOS has only a 0-rating entrant (Numo). Launches last 6 months: not counted. Trademark (NS&I/Premium Bonds) review risk.

idea: Octopus Energy smart-tariff companion taking over OctoTracker's stale user base (widgets, cheapest-slot alerts)
evidence: OctoTracker stale on both stores: iOS 4.8★/1,173 ratings, last update 25 Jun 2025 (v7 QC); Android 4.8★/443 reviews, 10k+, updated 25 Jun 2025. But a newer entrant 'OctoDash: Octopus Agile Rates' (Android 4.8★/49, 1k+, updated 25 Sep 2026) and 'Octopus Watch' (4.5★/940, 10k+, Jul 2026) are active.
moat_note: Copying already under way (OctoDash). Depends on Octopus public API and Octopus's own app (very large install base) not absorbing the features.

idea: FreeAgent connector layer for orphaned users: e-commerce/Stripe settlement posting + missing automation actions (invoice creation etc.)
platform: Shopify App Store / Zapier / FreeAgent ecosystem
evidence: FreeAgent closed its own Shopify integration 30 Apr 2025 (v7 Shopify scan). Zapier FreeAgent actions limited to Create Contact/Task; FreeAgent staff, 23 Feb 2026: 'the team responsible for this area don't have the capacity to expand out the Zapier functionality, so no work is planned'. Paid entrants: Equali ($23-47/mo, Shopify app 1.0★/1 review on 22 Oct 2026; officially listed by FreeAgent with 20% discount) and Bridging Ledger. Make.com already covers FreeAgent invoices.
stated_problem: 'I'd like to have an invoice created in FA when that is triggered. Currently you can only Create a Task or Contact. Why is it not possible to create an Invoice?' (Martin_Kay, FreeAgent API forum, 6 Feb 2026)
moat_note: Two paid entrants in ~12 months (Equali Apr 2026 Shopify launch, Bridging Ledger); Equali now has FreeAgent's official listing, a distribution moat a newcomer lacks. Accounting-correctness and support load raise the bar (some moat once built). Zapier-actions gap is cheap to fill but also cheap to copy and Make already fills it.

idea: Replacement Google Chat notifications app for Jira Cloud (incumbent stale since 2021, 2.3★)
evidence: 'Google Chat for Jira Cloud': 11,008 installs, 2.30★ from 109 reviews, latest version released 11 Nov 2021. Alternatives: 'Advanced Google Chat for Jira' 406 installs, 5.0★/3 (first version Mar 2024); 'Google Chat for Jira' 123 installs, 4.06★/4; 'Google Chat Automation Actions for Jira' 3 installs (release Nov 2025).
stated_problem: 'Doesn't work. Impossible to set up. Requires me to turn off security settings in order to enable.' (1★, 14 Aug 2026); 'The app is very old, the project search and the notifications... does not work' (1★, 25 Feb 2026)
moat_note: 3 alternatives exist (1 released in last ~12 months) yet the stale incumbent keeps 11k installs: switching is slow, so the gap is real but not exclusive. Forge app is cheap to clone. Atlassian takes a revenue share (rate unverified).

idea: Harvest time-tracking integration for Jira Cloud (official app stale since 2021)
evidence: 'Harvest Time Tracking (Official)': 2,439 installs, 2.53★/145, last release 29 Jun 2021. '…by 42nd' 375 installs 4.26★/27. Three more Harvest apps with releases in Sep-Oct 2026 (Twinsun 27 installs, marcelbag 9, Metronome 3).
stated_problem: 'Does not integrate with JIRA time tracking fields and features.' (1★, 1 May 2024); 'Does not even allow you to record time against a JIRA ticket on a different date' (1★, 20 Mar 2025)
stale_reason: newest complaint 19 months old (>18 mo) + platform-specific
moat_note: FAILS moat: 3 new entrants with Sep-Oct 2026 releases (launch dates not confirmed) — the Royal Mail pattern on Atlassian. Small base (2.4k installs).

idea: General pattern: replace orphaned official integrations on Atlassian Marketplace (vendor shut down or stopped updating)
evidence: Of 6,832 cloud apps, 18 with >=1,000 installs have had no release since before 23 Oct 2024 (e.g., Miro for Jira 12,250 installs 3.89★, last 8 Mar 2024; Render Markdown 3,853, 3.46★, Oct 2021; Azure Pipelines for Jira (Deprecated) 2,589, 2.11★/119, 2019; InVision for Jira 2,732, 2.96★/76). InVision shut down and two 'InVision & Freehand+' replacement apps were released 22 Oct 2026.
moat_note: Copy speed is high: orphan events (InVision) drew replacements quickly; Harvest drew 3. Only orphans with no named successor and >5k installs are worth it — currently just Google Chat (SC05). Raw data: raw/atlassian_cloud.json.

idea: Better Mermaid diagram app for Confluence Cloud
evidence: Leaders are weakly rated: Atlassian 'Mermaid diagrams viewer' 7,685 installs 2.99★/26; 'Mermaid Chart for Confluence' 4,089 installs 2.84★/20. But 84 apps match 'mermaid', several 4.0-4.6★ and updated Sep-Oct 2026.
moat_note: FAILS moat: 84 matching apps, many actively updated. Not a quiet corner.

idea: Third-party fix for Stripe/PayPal-to-Xero payment feeds (lowest-rated big Xero apps)
evidence: Of 435 Xero app pages read (sitemap; partial store), weakest big incumbents are first-party or payment-provider apps: Stripe 2.47★/383 (newest review 7 Oct 2026), Hubdoc 3.29★/232, PayPal 3.47★/136. Stripe complaints are mostly about fees and Xero's account-creation flow, not features a third party can fix. 23 of 435 apps listed since 23 Apr 2026.
stated_problem: 'Instead of linking to your existing account, Xero create a new account, and take a €99 fee from the first payment without giving any notice.' (1★, 7 Oct 2026)
moat_note: Not addressable: complaints target the payment provider/Xero; Stripe-to-Xero reconciliation already served by established connectors (A2X 4.96★/945 seen; others unverified count).
coverage: partial (464 sitemap apps; Xero search is client-rendered)

idea: Xero data export/archive tool for businesses leaving Xero or needing backups
evidence: XportMyData 2.82★ from 11 reviews, listed Oct 2020, newest review Feb 2024. Thin supply signal only; demand unmeasured.
moat_note: Unknown competition outside the sitemap sample; demand unproven. Low priority.

idea: UK smart-meter / home-energy data companion app (consumer)
evidence: Google Play 'smart meter' (GB): Loop Energy 2.0★, 100k+ downloads, updated 13 Jul 2026; ivie 3.9★/659, 50k+, updated Feb 2026; Smart Meter Pro 4.9★/251, 5k+, Jul 2026.
moat_note: Data access is the moat and the blocker: consumer smart-meter data needs a consent-based data provider (route and cost unverified). Big-install incumbents are weak but active.

idea: UK tide-times app replacing stale 'Tide Times UK'
evidence: 'Tide Times UK' Android 4.0★/223, 10k+, last updated 25 Jan 2020 (iOS 6,046 ratings, last update 6 Mar 2021 per v7 QC). But 'My Tide Times' 4.8★, 1m+ and several 4.7-4.8★ apps updated Oct 2026.
moat_note: FAILS moat: well-served by active apps; UKHO data licensing (cost unverified).

idea: UK-specific digital templates (landlord compliance kits, Right to Rent logs, HMRC/self-assessment trackers) on Gumroad/Etsy
evidence: Gumroad search today: 'uk landlord' 8 products, 'hmrc' 16, 'mtd' 4, 'uk budget spreadsheet' 5; nearly all 0 ratings, so supply is thin but no demand proof. Etsy top digital sellers are mass PLR bundles at £1.49-£1.65 with 600-800 reviews (fetched via search). Kupkaike (Apr 2026, 400+ listings) says profession-specific and life-admin templates are growing.

coverage: partial (Gumroad search JSON; Etsy via WebSearch only)

idea: Productised recurring spreadsheet/CSV/n8n workflow automation sold as a fixed-scope gig
evidence: Upwork (2 Jul 2026): AI-skill demand +109% YoY, AI integration +178%, e-commerce management +130%. Fiverr June 2026 index (via search synthesis): n8n automation searches +125%; 716 'UK bookkeeping' gigs. Several fixed-price 'recurring Excel/CSV workflow' products already listed on Upwork ($59-199 tiers).

idea: UK statutory inspection/certificate SaaS for a narrow trade (fire, LOLER lifting, F-gas, etc.)
evidence: FireCert (founded Feb 2026, UK): ~$4,515 MRR, 39 subs at £79-129/mo, Stripe-verified per wlad.me (5 Oct 2026). LolerFlow: 5 companies at £250/mo after 6 months (LinkedIn, 4 Aug 2026).

rule_flags: sells to local trade businesses (ruled out)

evidence: Community post (21 Sep 2026) says payment-level sync and fee/refund reconciliation break; 0 replies seen; post reads like vendor research. Existing apps: Invoice Stack, Inbound Addons Xero, Synder, HubSpot native QBO.
stated_problem: 'Getting "invoice marked paid" to flow through cleanly seems to be the sticking point.' (HubSpot Community, 21 Sep 2026)

idea: Cheap Companies House software accounts filing for dormant/micro companies (software-only filing mandate)
evidence: Date conflict: The Accountant/Yahoo article says 1 Apr 2027; the GOV.UK news URL used in v7 says April 2028 — must resolve on GOV.UK. Product Hunt shows UK micro-company and tax tools launching with little traction (Bridgly £2.99/mo, 6 upvotes; AbraTax 6 upvotes; TaxZap seed-funded, 130k+ clients). v7: ~50 CT600 suppliers, dormant filing from £5.
stale_reason: conflicting mandate dates; older article likely superseded
